text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One ran powerfully in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Though she left the audience 
stunned and felt satisfied with her run, 
she refrained from her usual rowdy 
celebrations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having only just begun her climb to the 
"top" of the Central League— Inari One 
remained on edge. Her next goal was set 
for the Takarazuka Kinen.
